description: This file defines a Spring MVC controller handling user profile actions, including viewing and editing user information with role-based security.

classes.name: SecurityController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing user profile retrieval and modifications with role-based security enforcement.

methods.name: getUserProfile
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/profile'; retrieves and displays the authenticated user's profile and associated course registrations.

methods.name: getForEdit
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/user/edit/{userID}'; prepares user data for editing if the user is authorized.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Handles POST requests to '/user/edit/{userID}'; updates user details if properly authorized.

methods.name: patchUser
methods.description: Handles POST requests to '/user/patch/{id_user}'; updates specific user details in a partial manner if authorized.
